title: 1991 Toyota Land Cruiser LJ77 LX
story: This LJ77 is a Spanish-market diesel 70 Series wagon, powered by Toyota's 2.4L 2L-T turbodiesel inline-four and backed by a five-speed manual with a dual-range transfer case. It's a factory configuration the U.S. never got, built for durability and low-end torque rather than outright power.

At roughly 211,000 miles, it remains close to factory spec: original alloy wheels, chrome bumpers, running boards, and a gray cloth interior with removable third-row seating for up to eight passengers. Rather than an unfinished project, this is a largely original example.

Imported from Spain and acquired by Wilder Customs in 2025, the title VIN matches the chassis stamping and the truck carries a clean title with documented U.S. history — important confidence points for any imported Land Cruiser.
